primary.description: Deep Blue / Slate 900 - Main brand color, used for headers, footers, primary actions

accent.description: Bronze / Yellow 700 - Subtle accents, lines, active states. NOT for main buttons

background.description: White and very light slate for sections. Ample whitespace.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-sm px-8 py-3 text-sm font-medium tracking-wide transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 hover:border-slate-900 rounded-sm px-8 py-3 text-sm font-medium tracking-wide transition-all duration-300

cards.strategy: bg-white p-8 border-t-2 border-transparent hover:border-bronze-600 transition-all duration-300 group hover:-translate-y-1 h-full

map.interactive: Use react-simple-maps or custom SVG. Countries: France, Germany, Benelux, Spain, Italy. Highlight on hover. Default fill: Slate-200. Hover fill: Bronze-600/20. Stroke: White.

homepage.hero: Full height (min-h-[80vh]). Split layout or centered institutional message. Background: Subtle architectural texture or clean white with heavy typography.
homepage.grid: Bento Grid Mode A (Asymmetrical) for Strategy preview.
homepage.approach: Interactive Map section. Clean, ample whitespace.

strategies.layout: Grid of 4 cards. High imagery. 2x2 grid on desktop.
strategies.details: Modal or expanded view for details.

assets.icons: Phosphor Icons (Light weight) or Lucide React (Stroke 1.5)
assets.logo_placeholder: Use text 'FINXIA CAPITAL' in Playfair Display Bold if image not provided.

content_guidelines.language: Bilingual (FR/EN). Default to French if not specified, but provide Toggle.
restrictions: NO 'Sign up now' buttons (Use 'Contact Us' or 'Inquire')

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Playfair Display' from Google Fonts via next/font or import in CSS.
Implement a LanguageContext to toggle between FR/EN text strings.
Ensure the 'European Approach' map is interactive (hover states for FR, DE, BE/NL/LU, ES, IT).
Contact form must point to 'contact@finxiacapital.com' (mailto behavior or simulated form submission).
Use the provided image URLs strictly. Do not search for new images unless absolutely necessary.
The footer must include legal notices placeholder.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
